summary_md: **Pete ([@pete_grow](https://x.com/pete_grow/status/2116435995335786588))** shares **Coral Discovery** by Ren et al. ([arXiv 2610.33281](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.33281v1)), a team of LLM research agents that improves programs against a deterministic grader; borrowing Philip Kitcher's idea of dividing cognitive labor, it keeps agents from all chasing the leading idea and validates each gain on held-out data. He thanks collaborators at Harvard, Cambridge, KCL, Trento and Hull.

referenced_urls.title: Coral Discovery: The Division of Cognitive Labor in Autonomous Research

relevance: Multi-agent autonomous research with diversity of approaches.
